Kashini — Fine Jewellery, brand identity.

The identity for a fine-jewellery house, built around a single mark: a lotus-filled “k.” From the logo it extends to a cusped Mughal arch, an interlocking jali lattice, a navy-and-gold palette, a gifting catalogue, and a live boutique at kashini.pages.dev — the full visual language for the brand, online. (Identity and branding; the jewellery is the house’s own.)

Branding · identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·40
